drivers.text: Growth was broad-based: Americas up 75% (66% organic), APAC up 50%, EMEA up 23%; acquisitions contributed about 6 points of the 61% growth. Management cites strong demand visibility and capacity investments and raised FY2026 net sales guidance by $650 million.
Adjusted operating margin rose 290 basis points to 25.2% on operating leverage and manufacturing productivity, partly offset by mix and growth investments.
Adjusted free cash flow rose on higher adjusted operating profit, partly offset by working capital build and higher capital expenditures to support growth; FY2026 capex still about 4.0% of revenue.
Management describes the largest infrastructure buildout accelerating, with more than 100% organic orders growth YoY and compressed product development cycles.
